analysis_source.role: repaired evaluator run against unchanged saved observations

phase255_diagnostic_sources.hosted_source_boundary: Hosted runs retain their original 7aae47281 producer identity. Later local repair commits were tested locally; they were not dispatched again under the closed hosted allowance.

statistics.median_method: ordinary median; for an even sample average the two middle sorted values
statistics.p95_method: nearest-rank ceil(0.95*n); for n=20 this is the 19th sorted value
statistics.p95_limitation: With only 20 pairs the tail estimate is fragile and does not guarantee population performance.

outcomes.failure_context: The first attempt failed admin-checkpoints-mobile LiveView readiness; the baseline run lacks successful full-lane family metadata.

preparations.details: Successful final preparation runs were preparation only. The comparison contains one baseline and one candidate invocation, both attempt 2.

reruns.note: The saved family cost rows retain the observed run attempt 2; earlier or unused attempts are not substituted for these rows.

cache_conditions.interpretation: The two retained invocations both report warm cache hits, but a pair-level 20-family allocation cannot be built from one failed baseline and one successful candidate.

runner_images.comparison_runner_labels: Retained job records show ubuntu-24.04 for required Playwright owners and the library shard; some other jobs use ubuntu-latest.
runner_images.captured_image: Both measured run metadata sets identify Linux X64, ubuntu24 image build 20261012.334.1.
runner_images.image_proof: The per-job measurement metadata contains runner-native image file hashes; this identity does not turn the failed baseline into a successful pair.

implemented_optimizations.scope: Development measurement only; no hosted performance claim.

implemented_optimizations.evidence: Source-bound local browser checks in Phase 254 Plans 03 and 04.
implemented_optimizations.scope: Behavior and local duration checks; no hosted performance claim.

implemented_optimizations.change: The five existing browser owners remained in place; no test owner was moved.
implemented_optimizations.evidence: The exact workload selection was retained.
implemented_optimizations.scope: No assertion that the changes reduced hosted end-to-end time.

reliability_fixes.controlled_connection_reproduction: A retired WebSocket could close its LongPoll replacement and trigger a LiveView registration reload. The controlled test reproduced this downstream race and the repair binds events to the physical connection.
reliability_fixes.original_initiating_event: unknown; the original hosted CI trace does not establish what delayed its primary response

phase255_diagnostics.auth_storage_sensitivity: Temporary authentication state and raw traces can contain session material; store privately, never commit, and use the sanitized tracked bundle for sharing.

trace_overhead.interpretation: Six local development observations on the final diagnostic code. No statistical speed claim and no correction or new samples for the closed comparison.

retrieval_attempts.note: The exact ref and package were fetched; the controller looked for its wrapper inside the analysis package, which intentionally does not include that distribution helper. No push retry occurred.

retrieval_attempts.checkout: Independent fresh repository fetched from the configured HTTPS remote URL, without clone hardlinks, alternates, inherited refs or original ignored data.

limitations.original_initiating_event: Unknown. The controlled connection reproduction establishes a later downstream race and repair, not the missing event in the original hosted failure.
limitations.native_parity: A successful candidate origin verification does not source-qualify the failed baseline; full native parity is unproven.
limitations.cache_and_images: The saved family metadata does not establish a matched cache vector or identical exact runner image for both measured sides.
limitations.missing_times: Missing baseline successful-required-context wait is null, never zero.
